verdict.rationale: telli documents dialing windows, calling strategies, and retry behavior (telli-docs-9) plus a schedule-call API endpoint that respects dialer windows or can bypass them (telli-docs-17, telli-docs-18) and reach-rate/success metrics (telli-docs-7), which together support scheduled, throughput-controlled outbound calling. However there is no explicit mention of a 'campaign' concept, bulk contact upload, or concurrency/rate limits for large batches. Missing for 10: explicit batch/campaign creation UI or endpoint, bulk contact import for calling, and documented concurrency/throughput limits beyond dialing windows.
